intelligence.essence: Frame the story like the calendar. A frame around each slide, the picture as big as the frame allows, a little writing with the image — and if there is no room, the writing goes on the next slide, so they look at the image, click, and the next slide tells them all about it. Sides alternating, so the brain keeps switching. Naya always there, picture in the corner, the red N marking the telling like a queen telling them about the new world. First slide: the bar, the video left, the play button right, "View Agreement" below. Last slide: the agreement itself — click AGREE and you're in, then your name. And over all of it, one charge: "I just want the presentation to be perfect."
